form.label: Troubleshooting
form.description: Break down Claude Desktop logs by level and host to spot trends, with a full event listing.

search.query: | metadata type=hosts index=claude | sort host | fields host

`claude_index` (sourcetype=claude:desktop:main OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:web OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork) | eval level=lower(coalesce(log_level, log_level_b)) | where isnotnull(level) | stats count by level | sort - count | fields level

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype=claude:desktop:main OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:web OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork) | eval level=lower(coalesce(log_level, log_level_b)) | where level IN ($level_tok$) | eval area=case(match(sourcetype,"mcp"),"mcp", match(sourcetype,"cowork"),"cowork", match(sourcetype,"web"),"web", true(),"desktop") | eval category=case( match(_raw, "net::ERR_") OR match(_raw, "networking is broken") OR match(_raw, "ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED") OR match(_raw, "EventLogging\] POST threw") OR match(_raw, "Failed to fetch") OR match(_raw, "fetch failed"), "network", match(_raw, "oauth") OR match(_raw, "OAuth") OR match(_raw, "session_stale_relogin") OR match(_raw, "Blocked permission check") OR match(_raw, "allowlist") OR match(_raw, "token cache"), "auth", match(_raw, "\[updater\]") OR match(_raw, "Auto-update"), "update", match(_raw, "RemotePluginManager") OR match(_raw, "SkillsPlugin") OR match(_raw, "PluginsFetcher") OR match(_raw, "Sync failed"), "plugin", match(_raw, "not found in installed extensions") OR match(_raw, "Server disconnected") OR match(_raw, "LocalMcpServerManager") OR match(sourcetype,"mcp"), "mcp", match(_raw, "SessionManager\] Cannot initialize") OR match(_raw, "persisted sessions"), "session", match(_raw, "Network Service process gone") OR match(_raw, "Uncaught") OR match(_raw, "Sentry caught") OR match(_raw, "watch-record") OR match(_raw, "BuddyBleTransport") OR match(_raw, "REACT_QUERY_CLIENT"), "crash", match(_raw, "MaxListenersExceededWarning"), "resource_leak", match(_raw, "Content Security Policy") OR match(_raw, "ProseMirror") OR match(_raw, "Deprecated API"), "ui_warning", match(_raw, "event-loop-stall"), "stall", true(), "other") | eval is_critical=if(level="error" AND (category="network" OR category="crash" OR category="auth"), 1, 0)
| stats count by category | sort - count
| chart count over host by level

| eval msg=substr(replace(_raw, "^\S+[ T]\S+\s*(\[\w+\]\s*)?", ""), 1, 160) | stats count as events dc(host) as hosts max(_time) as last_seen by category msg | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - events | head 30

| eval component=coalesce(component, mcp_server, "(none)") | eval detail=substr(replace(_raw, "^\S+[ T]\S+\s*", ""), 1, 300) | table _time host area level category component detail | sort - _time | head 100
